text: - **Ticks and slices.** One tick of `ref.sim.tick_period` (0.1 s of real time) runs as ten update slices. Every sliced pool advances about one tenth of its slots per slice, so every object advances exactly once per tick, in an order fixed by slot indices that every participant computes identically.
